system.description: Select 1 Talent and 1 Talent with the Divine trait. (Retired in the rules; kept here to test Talent slots.)
system.flavor: Your bond with your god opens new paths.

system.description: At the start of each encounter, choose one ally. While you are within 3 squares of them, you and they gain 1 Boon on Saves. (Not automated: choose the ally and add the Boon by hand.)
system.flavor: Your watchful presence protects one soul above all.

system.description: When you heal an ally with Lay On Hands, your next Smite is Empowered 2. It is used up by that Smite. (Not automated.)
system.flavor: Mercy shown is mercy returned.

system.description: While your Escalation is 2 or more, you and your allies in an Aura 3 around you gain 1 Boon on Saves against [Fear] Actions.
system.flavor: Your watch does not end when the fighting starts.
system.autoHover: Aura 3: Allies inside, and this creature, gain Divine Vigil (Boon against Fear). (while its Escalation is 2 or more).

system.description: While your Escalation is 2 or more, when an ally within 5 squares becomes Bloodied, you gain 1 Boon on your next [Strike] Action. (Not automated.)
system.flavor: Every wound your friends take is written in the ledger.

system.description: Choose one Projectile weapon, such as a bow or a crossbow. You start with **3 Mastery** with it, so its Weapon Technique is unlocked (see Mastery).
system.flavor: One weapon has been in your hands longer than any other.
system.autoHover: Choose one weapon with the property Projectile: it starts at 3 Mastery.

system.description: While your Escalation is 2 or more, if you have not left your square since the start of your last turn, gain 1 Boon on [Shot, Strike] Actions until you leave your square.
system.flavor: The shot is worth waiting for.

system.description: Once per round, when you deal damage to a creature with a [Melee, Strike] Action, you can challenge them: their [Strike] Actions against creatures other than you take 1 Bane (EoT). (Apply the Challenged effect from the compendium; its Bane counts only on Strikes against creatures other than you.)
system.flavor: You call them out, and they cannot look away.
system.automationNote: apply the Challenged effect from the compendium.

system.description: When a [Melee, Strike, Weapon] Action you make with a Two-handed weapon deals damage on a Tier 3, it deals 2 more.
system.flavor: Every swing carries the whole weight of the steel.
system.autoHover: Their Rolls with [Melee, Strike, Weapon, Two-handed weapon] Actions: an extra 2 [V] damage on T3.

system.flavor: You spin, and everything within reach feels the blade.
The red haze settles, and you stop caring about pain.

system.description: You gain the Pummel Action. Your @Book[Fists]{Fists} don't have the @Book[Non-threatening]{Non-threatening} property: you can flank with them.
system.flavor: Your hands have won more fights than any blade.
system.autoHover: Its Fists don't have the property Non-threatening.

system.description: You gain the Leg Sweep Action: a kick, so it needs no free hand. You can use it with your hands full.
system.flavor: Your legs hit as hard as your fists.
Patience turns a good shot into a sure one.
system.automationNote: the Weapon Attack with its Boon as a granted use (the card's button); Low cover gives it no Bane (the effect's Ignores cover setting).

system.description: With a @Book[Projectile]{Projectile} weapon, your far range has no Bane and your maximum range has 1 Bane instead of 2.
system.flavor: You pull a little further, and the arrow flies a little truer.
system.autoHover: Their Rolls with [Projectile] Actions: ignore one range Bane.

system.description: Your [Ranged] Actions don't take the Banes for being Engaged.
system.flavor: They are in your face. You are still calm.
system.autoHover: Their Rolls with [Ranged] Actions: ignore the Engaged Bane.

system.description: When you use Charge, your Speed counts as 2 higher for its movement, and its Weapon Attack (1A) is @Book[Empowered]{Empowered}.
system.flavor: Nothing slows you down once you start running.
You drive through the line without stopping, and strike as you pass.

system.description: Pick one blessing from the list below, related to a god you follow. You gain its Action. (More blessings will be added.)
system.flavor: A small gift from the god you follow.

system.description: You gain the Sacred Weapon Action.
system.flavor: You lay a hand on the steel and bless it for what comes next.

system.description: You gain the Hand of Mercy Action.
system.flavor: A single touch undoes what the enemy worked for.
system.automationNote: ending the effect (the Rally Point button works).

system.description: Choose one Encounter or Daily Action from your class's Repertoire that you don't have. You gain it. (Drag it from the compendium onto your sheet.)
system.flavor: You have studied your craft longer than most.

system.description: When you use a [Divine] Reaction (not Judge's 0R), you gain Guard equal to 1 + your Power Modifier.
system.flavor: Each time you answer for an ally, your god's light settles on you like mail.
system.automationNote: the Guard (1 + Pow, the higher kept) each time you use a [Divine] Reaction, while your Escalation is 2 or more.

system.description: The 1 AP use of Judge costs you 0 AP.
system.flavor: Your eye passes from one guilty foe to the next, and your god's attention follows it.
system.automationNote: Judge's 1 AP Version costs 0 AP while your Escalation is 2 or more.

system.description: A creature Judged by you has its Speed reduced by 2 (to a minimum of 1).
system.flavor: Your judgment hangs on your foe like a chain, and its steps drag.
system.automationNote: the Speed of the creature you Judged: by hand (its Speed reduced by 2, to a minimum of 1).

system.description: You gain 1 more Reaction Point when you regain AP. It pays only for [Divine] Reactions.
system.flavor: The longer the fight lasts, the less escapes you: your guard is on two allies at once.
system.automationNote: the second Reaction Point while your Escalation is 4 or more; that it pays only for [Divine] Reactions: by hand.

system.description: Once on your turn, a [Divine] Action you use gains "Setup: You Advance 3."
system.flavor: Your god's light carries you: wherever you are needed, you are already there.
system.automationNote: a [Divine] Action you use shows "Setup: You Advance 3" with its button while your Escalation is 6 or more; once on your turn: by hand.

system.description: The @Book[Lean]{Lean} Action costs you 0 AP.
system.flavor: A wall is a quiver's best friend: you are out, the arrow is gone, and you are back.
system.automationNote: Lean costs 0 AP while your Escalation is 2 or more.

system.description: Once on each of your turns, when you use a [Melee, Strike] Action after a [Ranged, Strike] Action this turn, or a [Ranged, Strike] Action after a [Melee, Strike] Action this turn, it gains 1 Boon.
system.flavor: Arrow, knife, arrow: each sets up the next.
system.automationNote: the Boon in the roll dialog, once on each of your turns, on a [Melee, Strike] after a [Ranged, Strike] (or the reverse) this turn, while your Escalation is 2 or more.

system.description: Your allies give your targets no Cover, and your [Ranged] Actions take no Field Bane for a target Engaged with one of your allies.
system.flavor: Your friends have learned where not to stand, and you have learned to shoot past their ears.
system.automationNote: your allies give your targets no Cover, and no Field Bane for a target Engaged with an ally, while your Escalation is 4 or more.

system.description: Once a round, when you get a Tier 3 with a [Ranged, Strike] Action against a creature, one ally who threatens it can spend 1R to make a Basic Attack (1A) against it.
system.flavor: Your arrow staggers the foe, and your ally's blade is already coming.
system.automationNote: on a Tier 3 of a [Ranged, Strike] Action, a line on the card names the allies who threaten the target; the ally's Basic Attack (1R) by hand, once a round.

system.description: Once on each of your turns, when a [Strike] Action of yours deals [W] on a Tier, it deals 1[W] more to each creature on that Tier.
system.flavor: By now your hands move faster than you can think: there is always one more arrow in the air.
system.automationNote: the first [Strike] that deals [W] on each of your turns deals 1[W] more (the damage roll), while your Escalation is 6.

system.description: Each Evade of yours moves you 1 more square, and your Evades can enter Difficult Terrain.
system.flavor: Nothing on this field is as fast as you are now.
system.automationNote: each Evade button moves you 1 more square while your Escalation is 6; entering Difficult Terrain with an Evade by hand.
